0014de190022.en: “Oh? You know this?” Eiri showed off the sigil ring in the middle and ring fingers of her right hand. The front contained two logograms, one of a body, and another of a circle with a broken piece being glued back together.
0014de190022.t: “Oh? Kau tahu benda ni?” Eiri menunjukkan cincin sigil pada jari tengah dan jari manis tangan kanannya. Bahagian depannya mengandungi dua logogram, satu tubuh, dan satu lagi bulatan dengan kepingan pecah yang dicantum semula.

03ae4cb5bd27.en: “I’m not sure how to say this, but everything feels off—” Harry bit his lips, seriously staring the wall painting down as if he was an art connoisseur.
03ae4cb5bd27.t: “Saya tak pasti macam mana nak cakap, tapi semuanya terasa tak kena—” Harry menggigit bibirnya, merenung lukisan dinding itu dengan serius seolah-olah dia seorang pakar seni.

05dcfa11a92f.en: Comforting Harry, Eiri said in a motherly tone, “Oh! Sorry, Harry—I forgot you don’t know about the change itself. It’s all gonna be over soon. I last used a nari gel quite a while ago, so I forgot about that too. The pain was a bit intense after the light sensitivity—yeah. There you go. That’s probably the peak right now. Just breathe—it will be over soon. Relax—yes, and don’t press your hands too hard into your eyes.”
05dcfa11a92f.t: Menenangkan Harry, Eiri berkata dengan nada keibuan, “Oh! Maaf, Harry—aku terlupa kau tak tahu pasal perubahan tu sendiri. Semuanya akan berakhir tak lama lagi. Kali terakhir aku guna nari gel dah agak lama, jadi aku pun terlupa pasal tu. Sakitnya agak kuat selepas peka cahaya—ha. Macam tu la. Mungkin itu kemuncaknya sekarang. Bernafas je—sekejap lagi habis. Bertenang—ya, dan jangan tekan tangan kau kuat sangat kat mata.”

06d32664635c.en: Harry saw Eiri massaging his hand, pushing the blood towards his thumb as if she was emptying out a toothpaste, making it heavily drip into the glass bottle. Continuously staring at the vivid red blood, Harry mustered a few words amongst the pained groans. “Wha—what is this for?”
06d32664635c.t: Harry melihat Eiri mengurut tangannya, menolak darah ke arah ibu jarinya seolah-olah sedang memicit ubat gigi, membuatkannya menitis deras ke dalam botol kaca. Terus merenung darah merah yang terang itu, Harry mengumpul beberapa patah kata di celah erangan kesakitan. “Untuk—untuk apa ni?”

098e79ec29ea.en: Harry did as told, and carefully took out the spoon from the glass, bringing out a hearty amount of the coagulated jelly, with the eyeball perfectly in the middle—looking like a true hors d'oeuvres. His hands slightly trembling caused the jelly to wave around, making it extra appetizing as he crossed sights with the iris of the lone eyeball, moving back and forth as well. With a visible gag, Harry clenched his jaw tightly shut, holding back something—possibly the late afternoon snack and dinner he recently had.
098e79ec29ea.t: Harry menurut, dan dengan berhati-hati mengeluarkan sudu itu dari kaca, membawa keluar sejumlah besar jeli yang membeku, dengan biji mata betul-betul di tengah—kelihatan seperti hors d'oeuvres yang sebenar. Tangannya yang sedikit menggeletar membuatkan jeli itu beralun, menjadikannya lebih menyelerakan ketika dia bertentang pandang dengan iris biji mata yang tunggal itu, turut bergerak ke depan dan ke belakang. Dengan rasa nak muntah yang ketara, Harry mengetap rahangnya rapat-rapat, menahan sesuatu—mungkin snek lewat petang dan makan malam yang baru dimakannya.

0b0a360a6a9d.en: Harry, with a tear rolling down his face, slowly opened his eyes, apparently trying to get his bearings of the room as if he was on a stage with a stage light pointed right at him. “Ohhhhhh! WOW!” Pure awe suddenly smeared across Harry’s face, as he observed over every single detail of the room, slowly moving his head and sparkling eyes around.
0b0a360a6a9d.t: Harry, dengan setitis air mata mengalir di wajahnya, perlahan-lahan membuka matanya, nampaknya cuba memahami keadaan bilik seolah-olah dia di atas pentas dengan lampu pentas dihalakan tepat kepadanya. “Ohhhhhh! WOW!” Kekaguman tulen tiba-tiba terpalit di wajah Harry, ketika dia memerhati setiap butiran bilik itu, perlahan-lahan menggerakkan kepala dan matanya yang berkilauan ke sekeliling.

0b17c9de5db3.en: Eiri let a long breath through her nose, clenching her teeth as she remembered Neferteri’s checkmate expression, as her elegant smile and soft expression complemented her chin-up attitude. “Fine! Have it your way, but I’m gonna make sure Harry has everything he needs. There you go, you happy now?” Eiri looked back at Coema’s painting on the wall, but no response came back from it.
0b17c9de5db3.t: Eiri menghembus nafas panjang melalui hidungnya, mengetap gigi ketika teringat riak Neferteri yang seperti mematikan buah catur, ketika senyuman anggun dan riak lembutnya melengkapi sikap dagu terangkatnya. “Baiklah! Ikut suka mak la, tapi aku akan pastikan Harry dapat semua yang dia perlukan. Hah, puas hati sekarang?” Eiri memandang semula lukisan Coema di dinding, tetapi tiada jawapan yang datang daripadanya.

0b230a07c06a.en: Exchanging gaze with the eyeballs immersed in the liquid, Harry looked like a skittish animal, waiting to be executed on the spot. His hands were still prepared to slap the macabre thing away, but they seemed to become less defensive as Eiri kept pushing it.
0b230a07c06a.t: Bertukar renungan dengan biji-biji mata yang terendam dalam cecair itu, Harry kelihatan seperti haiwan yang gementar, menunggu untuk dihukum mati di tempat. Tangannya masih bersedia menepis benda mengerikan itu, tetapi ia kelihatan semakin kurang defensif ketika Eiri terus menyuakannya.

0e5becd83bfa.en: “Sorry about dinner—it’s just—” Eiri, with slightly dull eyes, and weaker smile, stood by Harry, holding the bucket Neferteri had given her—“It’s just that I wanted you to make a decision for yourself.” The room had a background noise coming from the fost lamp steaming, showering the room in a while light.
0e5becd83bfa.t: “Maaf pasal makan malam tadi—cuma—” Eiri, dengan mata yang agak suram, dan senyuman yang lebih lemah, berdiri di sebelah Harry, memegang baldi yang diberikan Neferteri kepadanya—“Cuma aku nak kau buat keputusan sendiri.” Bilik itu mempunyai bunyi latar dari lampu fost yang berwap, menyimbah bilik itu dengan cahaya putih.

0eb46cedcc05.en: Chapter V subchapter 3: Harry rests his head on the shoulder of the blonde girl, who smiles with her eyes closed.
0eb46cedcc05.t: Bab V subbab 3: Harry melentokkan kepalanya di bahu gadis berambut perang, yang tersenyum dengan mata terpejam.

13da6ebcdf72.en: Harry’s flimsy eyes contrasted a firm silent nod, carefully laying out the contract on the table in front of him. “What should I do now?” His tone started to have a certain resolute air to it.
13da6ebcdf72.t: Mata Harry yang rapuh bertentangan dengan anggukan senyap yang tegas, dengan berhati-hati membentangkan kontrak itu di atas meja di hadapannya. “Apa saya patut buat sekarang?” Nadanya mula mempunyai aura nekad tertentu.

163b391bff0f.en: Bursting into a tense, yet mischievous short chuckle, Eiri thoroughly enjoyed Harry’s pure revulsion at what she had to offer, even taking an extra step to shove it towards his face. “What?”
163b391bff0f.t: Meledak dalam ketawa kecil yang tegang namun nakal, Eiri benar-benar menikmati rasa jijik tulen Harry terhadap apa yang ditawarkannya, malah melangkah lebih untuk menyuakannya ke mukanya. “Apa?”

17d998b69870.en: Gulping, Harry shook his head, holding back another gag as he stared at the nari gel.
17d998b69870.t: Menelan liur, Harry menggeleng, menahan satu lagi rasa nak muntah sambil merenung nari gel itu.

1d8e179bca05.en: “It is weird! But you told me to read a book, so I glanced at a few.” Harry, with mesmerized eyes, pointed to the five white rings around Eiri’s forearm, then at the single red ball of double helices that suddenly appeared, and spun around the smallest ring when she infused the power from the nari stone. “Wow! That’s pretty cool! It’s exactly like the drawings! I actually did not believe it at first!”
1d8e179bca05.t: “Memang pelik! Tapi awak suruh saya baca buku, jadi saya sempat tengok beberapa.” Harry, dengan mata terpukau, menunjuk ke arah lima gelang putih di sekeliling lengan bawah Eiri, kemudian ke arah sebiji bola merah heliks berganda yang tiba-tiba muncul, dan berputar di sekeliling gelang paling kecil apabila dia meresapkan kuasa dari batu nari itu. “Wow! Best gila! Sama betul macam lukisan! Saya sebenarnya tak percaya pada mulanya!”

1e43523d7258.en: Opening his eyes wide, Harry froze up, probably imagining his fate coming to an end—at least based on how he reacted.
1e43523d7258.t: Membuka matanya luas-luas, Harry membeku, mungkin membayangkan nasibnya menemui penghujung—sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan reaksinya.

20c2f3a10075.en: “I miss you.” Eiri recalled her and all the other maids giving her goodbyes at the port to Coema, as she sailed away in a large boat to Newland.
20c2f3a10075.t: “Aku rindu mak.” Eiri teringat dirinya dan semua pembantu rumah lain mengucapkan selamat tinggal kepada Coema di pelabuhan, ketika dia belayar pergi dengan kapal besar ke Newland.

21d7b05cbd2a.en: “It’s okay, Harry.” Eiri gently smiled as her hand slowly rubbed his hair. “I know it sucks for a bit. Sorry for not telling you, but it really will be over soon.”
21d7b05cbd2a.t: “Tak apa, Harry.” Eiri tersenyum lembut sambil tangannya perlahan-lahan menggosok rambutnya. “Aku tahu teruk sekejap. Maaf sebab tak bagi tahu kau, tapi betul, sekejap lagi habis.”

24cc58702674.en: “Yeahhhh, but look on the bright side! It’s a one-time thing.” Eiri put away the nari gel in the bucket. “You might still whoop her ass though, and if you do that, you would instantly become richer than I am. If you think about it, she does have a cute ponytail that you can pull on when you ride her.” Eiri giggled, making a tugging hand motion.
24cc58702674.t: “Haaaa, tapi tengok sisi baiknya! Sekali je.” Eiri menyimpan nari gel itu dalam baldi. “Kau mungkin masih boleh belasah dia, dan kalau kau buat macam tu, kau serta-merta akan jadi lebih kaya daripada aku. Kalau difikirkan, dia memang ada ekor kuda comel yang kau boleh tarik bila kau tunggang dia.” Eiri mengekek, membuat gerakan tangan menarik.

26a528191ee0.en: Eiri had a faint look of glee on her face, imagining Neferteri. There you go. I’m gonna show you how much I can be just like my mother.
26a528191ee0.t: Eiri mempunyai riak gembira yang samar di wajahnya, membayangkan Neferteri. Hah, ambik kau. Aku akan tunjuk betapa aku boleh jadi sama macam mak aku.

276410402a5d.en: “Hmmm? Never heard of that, but that sounds more like an interface than a weapon—except you can’t use it. Gandew rules only allow weapons, and I am pretty sure that’s what Maiara wants, too.” Eiri grabbed the nari gel, half-consumed with only two eyeballs left inside, and held it up. “Even nari gels are forbidden too, but I’m sure a simple fake eye will be spared.”
276410402a5d.t: “Hmmm? Tak pernah dengar pula, tapi bunyinya lebih macam antara muka daripada senjata—cuma kau tak boleh guna. Peraturan Gandew cuma benarkan senjata, dan aku agak pasti itu yang Maiara nak juga.” Eiri mengambil nari gel itu, yang separuh habis dengan hanya dua biji mata tinggal di dalamnya, dan mengangkatnya. “Nari gel pun dilarang juga, tapi aku pasti fake eye yang ringkas akan dikecualikan.”

2934f35e2c3a.en: With a stuck-out pinky, Eiri smiled. “Don’t tell them I said that, but you get it—she does have her own charms too, but at least you have a way out if she’s not your type.” Eiri pulled out the contract, and smilingly handed it towards him. “So—can you please sign it? For yourself—but also for me?”
2934f35e2c3a.t: Dengan jari kelingking terjulur, Eiri tersenyum. “Jangan bagi tahu mereka aku cakap macam tu, tapi kau faham—dia ada daya tarikan tersendiri juga, tapi sekurang-kurangnya kau ada jalan keluar kalau dia bukan jenis kau.” Eiri mengeluarkan kontrak itu, dan sambil tersenyum menghulurkannya kepadanya. “Jadi—boleh tak kau tolong tandatangan? Untuk diri kau—tapi juga untuk aku?”

29725ac1f52b.en: “So now you’re checking the time, right?” Harry stood up, and approached the timekeeper still facing the window. He saw a deep green section near three o’clock light up, with a slight light appearing to ooze into the next chunk of time. “Monni—high? Right? Wait. I’m seeing a bit of—Monnolow light up too. That’s different from when Sora showed me.”
29725ac1f52b.t: “Jadi sekarang awak tengah tengok masa, kan?” Harry berdiri, dan mendekati timekeeper yang masih menghadap tingkap. Dia nampak bahagian hijau tua berhampiran pukul tiga menyala, dengan sedikit cahaya kelihatan meresap ke bahagian masa seterusnya. “Monni—high? Betul? Kejap. Saya nampak sikit—Monnolow menyala juga. Lain daripada masa Sora tunjuk.”

2a31454e67a3.en: “What does my mother have to do with it?” Eiri furrowed her brow, still holding the bucket mid-air, apparently forgetting she was carrying it.
2a31454e67a3.t: “Apa kena-mengena mak aku dengan ni?” Eiri mengerutkan dahi, masih memegang baldi itu di udara, nampaknya terlupa dia sedang membawanya.

2b88f10520be.en: “Interface?” Harry still had a blanching face, but his furrowed brow and curious eyes no longer looked so averse at looking at the jellied eyeballs.
2b88f10520be.t: “Antara muka?” Wajah Harry masih pucat, tetapi dahinya yang berkerut dan matanya yang ingin tahu tidak lagi kelihatan begitu enggan memandang biji-biji mata berjeli itu.

2c85564173c1.en: Following suit, Harry took the fork end of the picker, and with shaking hands, prepared himself to stab the blue eye in the jar.
2c85564173c1.t: Menurut, Harry mengambil hujung garpu picker itu, dan dengan tangan menggeletar, bersedia untuk mencucuk mata biru dalam balang itu.

2c92b66151d8.en: Harry relaxed his hand for a bit, which was enough for a pool of blood to ooze out of his sliced thumb. Quickly, he replaced the cloth with the towel. Seeing Eiri rustle her hand on the bucket, his eyes could not help themselves. “That’s a sigil ring?”
2c92b66151d8.t: Harry melonggarkan tangannya sekejap, yang cukup untuk selopak darah meleleh keluar dari ibu jarinya yang terhiris. Cepat-cepat, dia menggantikan kain itu dengan tuala. Melihat Eiri menyelongkar baldi dengan tangannya, matanya tidak dapat menahan diri. “Itu cincin sigil ke?”

2dd58aac3c65.en: With a short sigh, Eiri lowered her gaze as well, and noticed something reddish in the bucket she was holding. With a renewed smile, she stuck her hand into it, and took out an oval-shaped glass with a large corkscrew on top. The corkscrew had Fake Eye written on it in dark red ink. The contents, meanwhile, were rather macabre: a blood-red liquid with jelly-like consistency, filled with suspended grains of what appeared to be sand, plus the crème de la crème of it all, four blue human eyeballs slightly squeezing one another into the sides of the glass, each staring in a random direction. With such an appetite-inducing thing in her hand, she brought it closer to Harry. “Hey—can we start by fixing your vision?”
2dd58aac3c65.t: Dengan keluhan pendek, Eiri turut menundukkan pandangannya, dan perasan sesuatu yang kemerahan dalam baldi yang dipegangnya. Dengan senyuman yang diperbaharui, dia menyeluk tangannya ke dalamnya, dan mengeluarkan kaca berbentuk bujur dengan pembuka gabus besar di atasnya. Pembuka gabus itu tertulis Fake Eye dengan dakwat merah gelap. Isinya, sementara itu, agak mengerikan: cecair merah darah dengan kepekatan seperti jeli, dipenuhi butiran terampai yang kelihatan seperti pasir, ditambah kemuncak segala-galanya, empat biji mata manusia biru yang sedikit menghimpit satu sama lain ke tepi kaca, setiap satu merenung ke arah rawak. Dengan benda yang membuka selera sebegitu di tangannya, dia mendekatkannya kepada Harry. “Hei—boleh kita mulakan dengan betulkan penglihatan kau?”

2df88fd527fa.en: “You sure?” Eiri bent forward, close to Harry’s level, to see his face.
2df88fd527fa.t: “Kau pasti?” Eiri membongkok ke depan, dekat dengan paras Harry, untuk melihat wajahnya.

31201f38d791.en: With curling lips and blanching face, Harry looked like he made deep eye contact with one of the eyeballs—like he was being stared at by a lone drunk obese girl at the last call of a bar.
31201f38d791.t: Dengan bibir mencebik dan wajah pucat, Harry kelihatan seperti bertentang mata dalam-dalam dengan salah satu biji mata itu—seperti direnung oleh seorang gadis gemuk mabuk yang bersendirian pada panggilan terakhir di bar.

322ea55e644c.en: Eiri opened the door, “Just hang tight until tomorrow! Don’t worry about the desk, the maids will clean it in the morning. Just go to sleep! Good night, Harry!” Eiri was about to close the door when she stopped herself. “Do you know how to put out the fost lamp?”
322ea55e644c.t: Eiri membuka pintu, “Bertahan je sampai esok! Jangan risau pasal meja tu, pembantu rumah akan kemas pagi esok. Pergi tidur je! Selamat malam, Harry!” Eiri hendak menutup pintu apabila dia menahan dirinya. “Kau tahu macam mana nak padamkan lampu fost?”

3337413754da.en: “Off? Like what?” Eiri eyebrows slightly raised, while her beautiful green eyes kept seeing Harry’s eyes growing droopy.
3337413754da.t: “Tak kena? Macam mana?” Kening Eiri sedikit terangkat, sementara mata hijaunya yang cantik terus melihat mata Harry semakin layu.

34bd7c9bed88.en: An embarrassed preemptive giggle came out of Harry, pulling his belly away from Eiri’s powerful pinchers. “I—I guess so.”
34bd7c9bed88.t: Ketawa kecil malu yang mendahului keluar daripada Harry, menarik perutnya menjauhi cubitan kuat Eiri. “Sa—saya rasa macam tu.”

3659a7bbc9da.en: Nearly choking in the process, Harry managed to swallow the eyeball, making his throat bulge as it rolled down his esophagus. He massaged his chest, probably feeling the eyeball slowly travel to his stomach.
3659a7bbc9da.t: Hampir tercekik dalam proses itu, Harry berjaya menelan biji mata itu, membuatkan kerongkongnya membonjol ketika ia bergolek turun ke esofagusnya. Dia mengurut dadanya, mungkin merasakan biji mata itu perlahan-lahan bergerak ke perutnya.

386b02223426.en: Bending forward, holding back his face away from the nearby fost lamp, tears poured down Harry’s eyes as he groaned. “Why?” A faint voice slipped out of him.
386b02223426.t: Membongkok ke depan, menjauhkan mukanya dari lampu fost berdekatan, air mata mencurah dari mata Harry sambil dia mengerang. “Kenapa?” Suara lemah terlepas daripadanya.

3b520dbca7db.en: “I’m gonna find his home!” The words slipped out under her breath as she saw a reflection of herself in the window.
3b520dbca7db.t: “Aku akan cari rumah dia!” Kata-kata itu terlepas perlahan dari mulutnya ketika dia melihat pantulan dirinya di tingkap.

3e77991e19bd.en: Doing as told, Harry put the soft white cloth where the knife was resting aside, and with a nice cork sound, Harry also got the glass jar open.
3e77991e19bd.t: Menurut, Harry meletakkan kain putih lembut tempat pisau itu terletak ke tepi, dan dengan bunyi gabus yang sedap, Harry turut membuka balang kaca itu.

3fbb91526547.en: “I don’t know what the symbols mean—body pie?” Harry’s new eyeballs could see the details of the logograms, but apparently their meaning remained elusive—like taking an inkblot test.
3fbb91526547.t: “Saya tak tahu apa maksud simbol-simbol tu—pai badan?” Biji mata baru Harry dapat melihat butiran logogram itu, tetapi nampaknya maknanya kekal sukar difahami—seperti mengambil ujian tompok dakwat.

3fe794f53694.en: Eiri stopped herself, crossing her arms as she bounced her neck around “—okay. That sounded bad. It’s not that bad; trust me. There are people living way worse lives than that. I mean, for starters, you would have a badge, which not everyone has. Plus, you could think of it as having a stable job for the next thirty-nine years, just traveling around the countryside in a peaceful job which does have its own charms.”
3fe794f53694.t: Eiri menghentikan dirinya, memeluk tubuh sambil lehernya terangguk-angguk “—okey. Bunyinya teruk. Tak teruk sangat pun; percayalah. Ada orang yang hidup jauh lebih teruk daripada tu. Maksud aku, sebagai permulaan, kau akan ada lencana, yang bukan semua orang ada. Tambahan pula, kau boleh anggap ia macam ada kerja tetap untuk tiga puluh sembilan tahun akan datang, cuma mengembara sekitar desa dalam kerja yang aman yang ada daya tarikannya tersendiri.”

4411273fd302.en: Eiri looked at the timekeeper. “Oh no! It’s that late! This means that we’re in between half timehunks, so I gotta go! The contact will pick up the blood at Monnalow, but I also need to give the contract to Neferteri.” She placed back the timekeeper in the bathroom drawer, then grabbed her bucket.
4411273fd302.t: Eiri memandang timekeeper itu. “Alamak! Dah lewat macam tu! Maknanya kita kat antara dua separuh timehunk, jadi aku kena pergi! Kenalan tu akan ambil darah pada Monnalow, tapi aku pun kena bagi kontrak tu kat Neferteri.” Dia meletakkan semula timekeeper itu dalam laci bilik mandi, kemudian mengambil baldinya.

4b0d743f629f.en: “Ow!” Harry looked like he was shocked in the arm—at least based on his jerking motion. He removed the towel around his thumb, and saw the flesh, blood vessels, and fat reconnect to one another from deep within, and reconnect to each other as the wound became shallower and shallower, while his thumb grew red and swollen. Apparently not believing what just happened, Harry touched the healed thumb, then squeezed it—apparently trying to see if it would split open again. “It feels warm and sore—is that what Maiara will do to me as well?”
4b0d743f629f.t: “Aduh!” Harry kelihatan seperti terkena kejutan di lengan—sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan gerakannya yang tersentak. Dia membuka tuala di sekeliling ibu jarinya, dan nampak daging, saluran darah dan lemak bercantum semula dari dalam, dan bersambung antara satu sama lain ketika luka itu menjadi semakin cetek, sementara ibu jarinya menjadi merah dan bengkak. Nampaknya tidak percaya apa yang baru berlaku, Harry menyentuh ibu jari yang sudah sembuh itu, kemudian memicitnya—nampaknya cuba melihat sama ada ia akan terbelah semula. “Rasa hangat dan sengal—itu ke yang Maiara akan buat pada saya juga?”

4d784c08df4b.en: Neferteri continued speaking with her back turned to Eiri, “We shall not let Gabiro’s passing be in vain. He is supposed to have some sort of quality useful for this great kingdom of ours. Perhaps it is just hidden under the surface, and we might see it shine tomorrow—” Neferteri opened the door “—or during his time as Sanbi-eye.”
4d784c08df4b.t: Neferteri terus bercakap sambil membelakangi Eiri, “Kita tidak akan membiarkan pemergian Gabiro sia-sia. Dia sepatutnya mempunyai sejenis kualiti yang berguna untuk kerajaan kita yang hebat ini. Mungkin ia hanya tersembunyi di bawah permukaan, dan kita mungkin melihatnya bersinar esok—” Neferteri membuka pintu “—atau semasa dia menjadi Sanbi-eye.”

4dd21a5fb7ee.en: Harry, meanwhile, tightly held the white cloth with his fingers, watching it getting soaked in blood. “My—my finger is still bleeding. It’s starting to drip, too.” He kept being a soldier even though it started to look like he had lost a decent amount of blood.
4dd21a5fb7ee.t: Harry, sementara itu, memegang kain putih itu erat-erat dengan jarinya, melihatnya semakin basah dengan darah. “Jari—jari saya masih berdarah. Dah mula menitis juga.” Dia terus berlagak tabah walaupun dia mula kelihatan seperti telah kehilangan banyak darah.

4ee5853ef635.en: Chapter V subchapter 2: the blonde girl in a blue dress stands shyly in front of Harry, who sits holding a glass.
4ee5853ef635.t: Bab V subbab 2: gadis berambut perang bergaun biru berdiri malu-malu di hadapan Harry, yang duduk memegang gelas.

4fa41e72c3e0.en: “If that is indeed the case, then please—entertain me in explaining why he looked up to you for answers.” Neferteri’s head slightly bent to the side, holding her hands in front of her, seeking for an answer that she already knew.
4fa41e72c3e0.t: “Jika benar begitu, maka sila—layanlah saya dengan menjelaskan mengapa dia mendongak kepada anda untuk mendapatkan jawapan.” Kepala Neferteri sedikit terteleng ke sisi, memegang tangannya di hadapannya, mencari jawapan yang sudah pun diketahuinya.

506acf4413fc.en: “Yeah. If you economize a lot, or have someone else pay your expenses, or get more budget to begin with, then you could be free of it in less time. You could try to make money as well, but it will be tough since you will be busy doing Sanbi-eye stuff. Still—we’re talking thirty-nine years—which is half of your entire lifetime, if you make it to eighty. Actually—do you know how old you are?”
506acf4413fc.t: “Ha. Kalau kau berjimat banyak, atau ada orang lain bayar perbelanjaan kau, atau dapat bajet lebih dari awal, kau boleh bebas dalam masa yang lebih singkat. Kau boleh cuba cari duit juga, tapi susah sebab kau akan sibuk buat kerja Sanbi-eye. Tetap juga—kita cakap pasal tiga puluh sembilan tahun—iaitu separuh seluruh hayat kau, kalau kau sampai umur lapan puluh. Sebenarnya—kau tahu berapa umur kau?”

5228ec94a981.en: “Neferteri pressured me to make you sign the contract. That’s why I am here instead of one of my maids—she’s gonna vote me out of my position if you don’t sign it. I was thinking some more, too, and I think I might have scared you more than helped—I mean, the contract is not the worst thing ever, except you would be stuck with tier one wages doing Sanbi-eye work for like thirty-nine years, with no freedom to do stuff other than what Neferteri, and Itagiba tell you to—”
5228ec94a981.t: “Neferteri tekan aku untuk buat kau tandatangan kontrak tu. Sebab tulah aku ada kat sini dan bukannya salah seorang pembantu rumah aku—dia akan undi untuk singkirkan aku dari jawatan aku kalau kau tak tandatangan. Aku pun ada fikir lagi, dan aku rasa aku mungkin lebih menakutkan kau daripada menolong—maksud aku, kontrak tu bukanlah benda paling teruk pun, kecuali kau akan terperangkap dengan gaji peringkat satu buat kerja Sanbi-eye selama macam tiga puluh sembilan tahun, tanpa kebebasan buat apa-apa selain apa yang Neferteri, dan Itagiba suruh—”

55aadcb881ce.en: Eiri placed the bucket on the ground, then cutely held the back of her skirt as she sat down. With the macabre artifact in her hands, she uncorked it, making a nice pop sound. “What are you afraid of?” Eiri again brought it up closer to Harry, “It’s just fake eye nari gel! It doesn’t even taste that bad. C’mon!”
55aadcb881ce.t: Eiri meletakkan baldi itu di lantai, kemudian dengan comel memegang belakang skirtnya ketika dia duduk. Dengan artifak mengerikan itu di tangannya, dia membuka gabusnya, mengeluarkan bunyi pop yang sedap. “Kau takut apa?” Eiri sekali lagi mendekatkannya kepada Harry, “Ia cuma nari gel fake eye! Rasanya pun tak teruk sangat. Ayuh!”

56ab6c993c32.en: “Fairly simple. Procure a way for him to sign, and avoid indulging in your mother’s tendencies. Commit to those, and we shall be more prosperous than any other kingdoms. Otherwise, you should look forward to an early retirement.” Neferteri began walking away, turning back slightly, “Ensure you have enough blood for the badges as our contact will be waiting by the castle door at Monnolow.”
56ab6c993c32.t: “Agak mudah. Dapatkan cara untuk dia menandatangan, dan elakkan daripada menurut kecenderungan ibu anda. Komitlah pada kedua-duanya, dan kita akan lebih makmur daripada mana-mana kerajaan lain. Jika tidak, anda boleh menantikan persaraan awal.” Neferteri mula berjalan pergi, berpaling sedikit, “Pastikan anda mempunyai darah yang cukup untuk lencana kerana orang hubungan kita akan menunggu di pintu istana pada Monnolow.”

56cd211d8b4f.en: “Basically each week you will be given something like—” Eiri looked upwards, pausing for a second “—forty-eight pearls to do your job. Whatever is left at the end will be used to pay back the debt.”
56cd211d8b4f.t: “Pada dasarnya setiap minggu kau akan diberi lebih kurang—” Eiri mendongak, terhenti sesaat “—empat puluh lapan Pearl untuk buat kerja kau. Apa saja yang tinggal di hujungnya akan digunakan untuk bayar balik hutang.”

57590297ad25.en: Still bending forwards, a sniff came out of Harry, still protecting his eyes, but no longer whimpering.
57590297ad25.t: Masih membongkok ke depan, satu hingusan keluar daripada Harry, masih melindungi matanya, tetapi tidak lagi merengek.

59e1f483735d.en: Eiri, looking back at her mother’s painting, remembered when she was a girl, coming home from playing with her friends after fundamental school, and would see Coema at the dinner table by herself downing beer, wine, spirits, or a combo of it all in a given day, nearly passing out as she basically only talked about Neferteri, and what she did to pay back that bitch as she would eloquently often say as Eiri went to the kitchen to start cooking dinner. “No wonder you kept on talking so much about her—so what do I do now?”
59e1f483735d.t: Eiri, memandang semula lukisan ibunya, teringat ketika dia masih budak perempuan, pulang dari bermain dengan kawan-kawannya selepas sekolah asas, dan akan melihat Coema di meja makan seorang diri meneguk bir, wain, arak, atau gabungan semuanya pada hari tertentu, hampir pengsan sambil pada dasarnya hanya bercakap tentang Neferteri, dan apa yang dia lakukan untuk balas dendam pada perempuan sundal tu seperti yang sering dikatakannya dengan petah ketika Eiri pergi ke dapur untuk mula memasak makan malam. “Patutlah mak asyik cakap pasal dia—jadi apa aku nak buat sekarang?”

5d11a054ba10.en: The corner of Harry’s lips held back something, but soon after it dropped as he looked through the assortment of stuff in the nearby desk before pondering a drawing on the wall above it. The drawing itself was simply of a gentleman like Itagiba, but older, fishing in the clouds, resting in a boat pulled by what appeared to be a horse. “Is that a horse?”
5d11a054ba10.t: Sudut bibir Harry menahan sesuatu, tetapi tidak lama kemudian ia jatuh ketika dia meninjau pelbagai barang di meja tulis berdekatan sebelum merenung lukisan di dinding di atasnya. Lukisan itu sendiri hanyalah seorang lelaki seperti Itagiba, tetapi lebih tua, memancing di awan, berehat dalam perahu yang ditarik oleh sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti kuda. “Itu kuda ke?”

6023c2522ee7.en: I guess he has never seen that before. Eiri’s smile waned; she cradled the fake eye nari gel with both hands in her lap. “These gels are an interface to use the soul energy within us. How exactly? I have no idea, but if you swallow it, your eyeballs will be replaced with these ones—they are just like the blue of your eyes, so you can thank Eori for going the extra largeadi.”
6023c2522ee7.t: Rasanya dia tak pernah nampak benda ni. Senyuman Eiri pudar; dia mendakap nari gel fake eye itu dengan kedua-dua tangan di ribanya. “Gel-gel ni ialah antara muka untuk menggunakan tenaga jiwa dalam diri kita. Macam mana tepatnya? Aku tak tahu langsung, tapi kalau kau telan, biji mata kau akan diganti dengan biji mata ni—warnanya sama macam biru mata kau, jadi kau boleh berterima kasih pada Eori sebab sanggup pergi selargeadi lebih.”

609e4ad90ed1.en: Coema’s charm, or rather Eiri’s attempt at mimicking her mother’s charm, suddenly evaporated as flashbacks of previous meetings came to her. In the latest meeting she was outvoted three-to-one on nearly all votes, specifically how quickly Kibe only took a vote after Neferteri’s, barely making a peep about his own opinion—even less than usual given his personality. She then remembered that when Gabiro was the courtroom scientist, the dynamics were clearly different—more chaotic, sure, but the certainty of who would win in an argument was far less certain. Her memories were now filled with instances where she raised her voice, and Gabiro, sometimes even Itagiba sided with her. Feeling a chill run down her spine, she took a step back, resting her lower back on the edge of a large table by the window, and held her bucket with a firmer grip. “What do you even want from me?”
609e4ad90ed1.t: Pesona Coema, atau lebih tepat percubaan Eiri meniru pesona ibunya, tiba-tiba lenyap ketika imbasan mesyuarat-mesyuarat lalu datang kepadanya. Dalam mesyuarat terakhir dia kalah undi tiga lawan satu dalam hampir semua undian, khususnya betapa cepatnya Kibe hanya mengundi selepas Neferteri, hampir tidak bersuara tentang pendapatnya sendiri—lebih kurang daripada biasa memandangkan personalitinya. Dia kemudian teringat bahawa semasa Gabiro menjadi saintis istana, dinamiknya jelas berbeza—lebih huru-hara, memang, tetapi kepastian siapa yang akan menang dalam pertengkaran jauh kurang pasti. Ingatannya kini dipenuhi saat-saat di mana dia meninggikan suara, dan Gabiro, kadang-kadang malah Itagiba menyebelahinya. Merasakan kesejukan mengalir di tulang belakangnya, dia berundur selangkah, menyandarkan pinggang bawahnya pada tepi meja besar di tepi tingkap, dan memegang baldinya dengan cengkaman yang lebih kuat. “Apa sebenarnya yang awak nak daripada aku?”

60b05dc71f09.en: Harry immediately evacuated towards the other end of the bed, looking back at Eiri’s grin with a suspicious gaze, and tensed up posture, with hands ready to slap it away from his mouth. He groaned, then held back a gag as if he was on the brink of puking.
60b05dc71f09.t: Harry serta-merta berundur ke hujung katil yang lain, memandang semula sengihan Eiri dengan renungan curiga, dan postur tegang, dengan tangan bersedia menepisnya dari mulutnya. Dia mengerang, kemudian menahan rasa nak muntah seolah-olah dia di ambang termuntah.

61f78e52906f.en: “If you’re talking about wasters, then no. It will be actual weapons, but guns? What’s that?” Eiri’s ears were carefully listening, assuming she misheard something.
61f78e52906f.t: “Kalau kau maksudkan pedang kayu latihan, tak. Ia akan guna senjata sebenar, tapi senapang? Apa benda tu?” Telinga Eiri mendengar dengan teliti, menyangka dia tersalah dengar sesuatu.

62037d528c32.en: Coming back to him, Eiri dried her gloves and hands on a blue towel. “Use this while I get the Body Restore working” She gave him the blue towel, and placed the mostly dry yellow gloves on top of the bed.
62037d528c32.t: Kembali kepadanya, Eiri mengeringkan sarung tangan dan tangannya dengan tuala biru. “Guna ni sementara aku sediakan Body Restore” Dia memberinya tuala biru itu, dan meletakkan sarung tangan kuning yang hampir kering di atas katil.

6204dbd9ed59.en: “Everything—for I dealt with her meddling as king-maid for nearly as long as you’ve existed in this world. I know what you are capable of, and I am here to curb those flaws of your genes for the sake of our kingdom,” Neferteri spoke clearly, and firmly.
6204dbd9ed59.t: “Segala-galanya—kerana saya telah berurusan dengan campur tangannya sebagai king-maid hampir selama anda wujud di dunia ini. Saya tahu apa yang anda mampu lakukan, dan saya di sini untuk mengekang kelemahan dalam gen anda demi kerajaan kita,” Neferteri bercakap dengan jelas dan tegas.

638081f73730.en: Letting out a saddened hum, Harry left behind a vacant stare towards the contract in the bucket. “Hmmm. I tried to remember, but very vaguely—” Scratching his faint neck beard, he continued. “I can’t remember any details, but I have this feeling—that I did have a home—or maybe more like an apartment—I think. Maybe it was before I was in the slums? But I just have no feeling that I've ever been in one! There’s just something—”
638081f73730.t: Mengeluarkan dengungan sedih, Harry meninggalkan renungan kosong ke arah kontrak dalam baldi. “Hmmm. Saya cuba ingat, tapi sangat samar—” Menggaru janggut lehernya yang samar, dia menyambung. “Saya tak ingat apa-apa butiran, tapi saya ada perasaan ni—yang saya memang ada rumah—atau mungkin lebih macam pangsapuri—rasanya. Mungkin sebelum saya berada kat setinggan? Tapi saya langsung tak rasa saya pernah berada kat setinggan! Ada sesuatu—”

6610fcc7547a.en: Letting out a strained hum, Harry looked at Eiri as if she just handed him out a life sentence—including appearing to have listened to the sound of a judge's gavel’s snapping and the rumor of the present jury.
6610fcc7547a.t: Mengeluarkan dengungan tegang, Harry memandang Eiri seolah-olah dia baru menjatuhkan hukuman penjara seumur hidup kepadanya—termasuk kelihatan seperti telah mendengar bunyi ketukan tukul hakim dan desas-desus juri yang hadir.

683c414735e8.en: Harry, still trying to hold the blood-soaked white cloth around his thumb, used his free hand to carefully plug the cork.
683c414735e8.t: Harry, masih cuba memegang kain putih yang basah dengan darah di sekeliling ibu jarinya, menggunakan tangannya yang bebas untuk menyumbat gabus dengan berhati-hati.

6904e91e9709.en: “Horse? No. That’s an egua. Why? Are they like—the same thing?” Eiri looked towards the drawing as well, remembering how Itagiba’s father loved fishing by himself to recoup from dealing with everyone’s bitching.
6904e91e9709.t: “Kuda? Bukan. Itu egua. Kenapa? Mereka macam—benda yang sama ke?” Eiri turut memandang ke arah lukisan itu, teringat betapa ayahanda Itagiba suka memancing seorang diri untuk memulihkan diri daripada melayan rungutan semua orang.

6d82996d3efb.en: Eiri’s tone grew serious as well. “Okay—now, move the contract a bit here, and bring the plate with the knife closer.” Eiri pointed to a short knife, with a highly detailed carving of a Sanbi fish appearing to jump in the air.
6d82996d3efb.t: Nada Eiri turut menjadi serius. “Okey—sekarang, alihkan kontrak tu sikit ke sini, dan dekatkan pinggan dengan pisau tu.” Eiri menunjuk ke arah sebilah pisau pendek, dengan ukiran ikan Sanbi yang sangat terperinci kelihatan melompat di udara.

6e6683d6dd66.en: With a slight head bobble, and half a smile in one of Harry’s corners, he continued. “This contract is void if both parties imprint their blood in the respective section located in the back of the contract.” He flipped the page to check out the void section, completely unfilled, then he flipped back. Looking at the empty space in the bottom right of the contract, he saw his name written out Harry Sanbi. Broodingly, he twisted his neck, saying under his breath, “I think I’m ready to sign.”
6e6683d6dd66.t: Dengan anggukan kepala kecil, dan separuh senyuman di salah satu sudut bibir Harry, dia menyambung. “Kontrak ini terbatal jika kedua-dua pihak menerakan darah mereka di bahagian masing-masing yang terletak di belakang kontrak.” Dia menyelak halaman untuk melihat bahagian pembatalan, langsung tidak diisi, kemudian dia menyelak semula. Memandang ruang kosong di bahagian bawah kanan kontrak, dia nampak namanya tertulis Harry Sanbi. Termenung, dia memulas lehernya, berkata perlahan, “Rasanya saya dah sedia nak tandatangan.”

6eb04a7742dd.en: Reddening in the face, Harry smiled, but did not say anything.
6eb04a7742dd.t: Merah padam wajahnya, Harry tersenyum, tetapi tidak berkata apa-apa.

6ee65adedfdf.en: “Exactly! Even I need to take a break once a while!” Eiri let out a slight pout that quickly turned into a smile. “Anyway—just give it time. Just live in the present, and take one step at a time. I’m not a scientist, or a historian—I’m an accountant, and a chef, but I made a few friends along the way, and I promise I will reach out to everyone I know.” She took a long, reassured breath. “There has to be someone that heard your strange words—maybe a village hidden past the four kingdoms! I will even ask Mom when she comes back from Newland! I guarantee she must know someone who can help.”
6ee65adedfdf.t: “Tepat sekali! Aku pun perlu berehat sekali-sekala!” Eiri memuncung sedikit yang cepat bertukar menjadi senyuman. “Apa-apa pun—beri masa. Hidup je pada masa kini, dan ambil satu langkah demi satu langkah. Aku bukan saintis, atau ahli sejarah—aku akauntan, dan tukang masak, tapi aku ada berkawan dengan beberapa orang sepanjang jalan, dan aku janji aku akan hubungi semua orang yang aku kenal.” Dia menarik nafas panjang yang yakin. “Mesti ada seseorang yang pernah dengar perkataan-perkataan pelik kau—mungkin sebuah kampung tersembunyi di sebalik empat kerajaan! Aku siap akan tanya mak bila dia balik dari Newland! Aku jamin mesti dia kenal seseorang yang boleh tolong.”

70f1723a0804.en: Harry took a deep sigh of relief, cleaning away the tears on his arm. “Paid time off?”
70f1723a0804.t: Harry menghembus keluhan lega yang dalam, mengesat air mata pada lengannya. “Cuti bergaji?”

7254e5eeec77.en: Narrowing her eyes, Eiri crossed her arms, trying to juggle her memory “Ahhhh—there is a Forway duel and a Gandew duel. A Forway duel is when two or more people just start fighting until a winner comes out on top. A Gandew duel is two people, taking turns, either attacking or defending a single attack. Whoever dies first, loses.”
7254e5eeec77.t: Mengecilkan matanya, Eiri memeluk tubuh, cuba menyusun ingatannya “Ahhhh—ada pertarungan Forway dan pertarungan Gandew. Pertarungan Forway ialah bila dua orang atau lebih mula bertarung sehingga seorang pemenang muncul di atas. Pertarungan Gandew ialah dua orang, bergilir-gilir, sama ada menyerang atau mempertahankan satu serangan. Sesiapa yang mati dulu, kalah.”

741a3cc2daaf.en: “Close! Body Restore. So this isn’t weird for you?” Eiri asked, grabbing one of the standalone nari stones resting on top of the table to infuse its soul power into the spell she was about to cast.
741a3cc2daaf.t: “Dekat! Body Restore. Jadi ni tak pelik untuk kau?” Eiri bertanya, mengambil salah satu batu nari yang berasingan di atas meja untuk meresapkan kuasa jiwanya ke dalam jampi yang hendak dilepaskannya.

75b6a2cc01a6.en: Seated at the corner of the bed, as if he was waiting at the lobby of a doctor’s office, Harry looked back at Eiri, nodding before returning his gaze to the ground in front of him. “But—I don’t know what to do.”
75b6a2cc01a6.t: Duduk di sudut katil, seolah-olah dia sedang menunggu di lobi pejabat doktor, Harry memandang semula Eiri, mengangguk sebelum kembali merenung lantai di hadapannya. “Tapi—saya tak tahu apa nak buat.”

78d5ced10d7d.en: Neferteri stopped, but did not turn back. She held her hands at the door, but did not open them. “Gabiro enhanced him.”
78d5ced10d7d.t: Neferteri berhenti, tetapi tidak berpaling. Dia memegang pintu, tetapi tidak membukanya. “Gabiro menambah baik dirinya.”

7a8325c7d834.en: “So what do I do now?” Harry stood motionless in the room, looking like a dog seeing all family members leave for the day, knowing he will be alone.
7a8325c7d834.t: “Jadi apa saya nak buat sekarang?” Harry berdiri kaku dalam bilik, kelihatan seperti anjing yang melihat semua ahli keluarga keluar untuk hari itu, tahu dia akan bersendirian.

7ca8f95f7da4.en: “You’re gonna love it when it is all said and done. Just be a man, and swallow it whole. Just one large gulp to be done with it.” Eiri scooched even closer to Harry, offering the nari gel right in front of him. “You can do it. You will thank me later.”
7ca8f95f7da4.t: “Kau akan suka bila semuanya dah selesai. Jadilah lelaki, dan telan bulat-bulat. Satu teguk besar je untuk selesaikan.” Eiri mengesot lebih dekat dengan Harry, menawarkan nari gel itu betul-betul di hadapannya. “Kau boleh. Kau akan berterima kasih kat aku nanti.”

7cc6d91241de.en: “I don’t know what you're talking about. Like you had a magnifier or something like that stuck on your eyes?” Eiri imagined two magnifiers, about three times the size of an eye stuck to one another above the nose—each looking as thick as if someone cut the bottom of a glass bottle. Continuing her imagination, she saw Harry wearing them, and his eyes enlarged by them, all before the whole apparatus suddenly felt forward for not having any way to stay in place.
7cc6d91241de.t: “Aku tak tahu apa yang kau cakap. Macam kau ada kanta pembesar ke apa yang melekat kat mata kau?” Eiri membayangkan dua kanta pembesar, kira-kira tiga kali ganda saiz mata yang dilekatkan antara satu sama lain di atas hidung—setiap satu kelihatan setebal seolah-olah seseorang memotong dasar botol kaca. Meneruskan imaginasinya, dia melihat Harry memakainya, dan matanya diperbesarkan olehnya, sebelum seluruh alat itu tiba-tiba jatuh ke depan kerana tiada cara untuk kekal di tempatnya.

8233d90cfe0b.en: “I can tell you it is the most economically viable one.” Eiri grinned, thinking of how much the bottle cost as she imagined passing by a Sanbi market stall with quite a few nari gels on display. “I’d say on the Sanbi market you can buy that for one amethyst and twenty pearls.”
8233d90cfe0b.t: “Aku boleh cakap itu cara yang paling berbaloi dari segi ekonomi.” Eiri tersengih, memikirkan berapa harga botol itu sambil membayangkan melalui gerai pasar Sanbi dengan banyak nari gel dipamerkan. “Aku rasa kat pasar Sanbi kau boleh beli tu dengan satu amethyst dan dua puluh Pearl.”

865737a79cac.en: Imagining a smaller rectangle magnifier, she now envisioned a tape that covered the eyebrow and upper part of the magnifier, seemingly to hold the glasses back from failing, but then touching the eyeballs if the person bent the head backwards since there was nothing stopping the glass from moving back and forth. “Pfff. Why would you ever wear something lame like that? There are so many fake eyes available out there!” Eiri’s tone suddenly took a downturn, her trembling eyes realizing just how weird that was. “You really have no memories of home?”
865737a79cac.t: Membayangkan kanta pembesar segi empat tepat yang lebih kecil, kini dia membayangkan pita yang menutup kening dan bahagian atas kanta pembesar itu, nampaknya untuk menahan cermin mata daripada jatuh, tetapi kemudian menyentuh biji mata jika orang itu mendongak kerana tiada apa yang menghalang kaca itu bergerak ke depan dan ke belakang. “Pfff. Kenapa kau nak pakai benda tak best macam tu? Ada banyak sangat fake eye kat luar sana!” Nada Eiri tiba-tiba menurun, matanya yang menggeletar menyedari betapa peliknya perkara itu. “Kau betul-betul tak ada ingatan pasal rumah?”

86e40f074275.en: Eiri, seeing Neferteri walk through the packed bookshelves towards the door, felt a grip on her heart. She swallowed her words at first, but then they came out raw, “But why do you want him specifically? It’s not even what Maiara wanted! Just—just let the poor thing go! He didn’t have a choice! Can’t you see he knows nothing?” Eiri slowly raised her voice at the queen of Sanbi. “That’s not fair to him!”
86e40f074275.t: Eiri, melihat Neferteri berjalan melalui rak-rak buku yang padat menuju ke pintu, merasakan cengkaman di jantungnya. Dia menelan kata-katanya pada mulanya, tetapi kemudian ia keluar dengan mentah, “Tapi kenapa awak nak dia secara khusus? Itu pun bukan apa yang Maiara nak! Cuma—lepaskan je benda malang tu! Dia tak ada pilihan! Awak tak nampak ke dia tak tahu apa-apa?” Eiri perlahan-lahan meninggikan suaranya kepada permaisuri Sanbi. “Itu tak adil untuk dia!”

897a0e081d75.en: Eiri, with a proud tone, stated, “Do the next one real quick!” She slowly tapped Harry in the back. “You will make it easier to feel both of your eyes change at the same time!”
897a0e081d75.t: Eiri, dengan nada bangga, berkata, “Buat yang seterusnya cepat-cepat!” Dia perlahan-lahan menepuk belakang Harry. “Nanti lebih senang kau rasa kedua-dua mata kau berubah serentak!”

8bf22ca3959d.en: “Don’t touch it too much. It will go away shortly, but yeah—she will heal you, or you will heal her instead. Depends on who wins! Can you roll the contract for me?” Eiri, putting on her yellow gloves, grabbed the contract from Harry, and stashed it away in the bucket. “The glass bottle as well, please!” Stashing the bloodied bottle as well, she then walked over to the bathroom, and pulled out a timekeeper from one of the drawers. “I’d say I will be busy until at least Sunnilow, so you might not be able to see me until the duel starts.” She then walked back to the bedroom, and pointed the timekeeper to the glass window. “I believe the duel itself is at Sunnolow, so you can sleep in as much as you want.”
8bf22ca3959d.t: “Jangan sentuh banyak sangat. Sekejap lagi hilang, tapi ha—dia akan sembuhkan kau, atau kau yang akan sembuhkan dia. Bergantung pada siapa yang menang! Boleh kau gulung kontrak tu untuk aku?” Eiri, memakai sarung tangan kuningnya, mengambil kontrak itu dari Harry, dan menyimpannya dalam baldi. “Botol kaca tu juga, tolong!” Turut menyimpan botol berdarah itu, dia kemudian berjalan ke bilik mandi, dan mengeluarkan timekeeper dari salah satu laci. “Aku rasa aku akan sibuk sekurang-kurangnya sampai Sunnilow, jadi kau mungkin tak dapat jumpa aku sampai pertarungan bermula.” Dia kemudian berjalan semula ke bilik tidur, dan menghalakan timekeeper itu ke tingkap kaca. “Aku rasa pertarungan tu sendiri pada Sunnolow, jadi kau boleh tidur selama mana kau nak.”

8c72b5649554.en: Harry seemed to start recalling something. “Duel? Is that the same as a Gandew duel?”
8c72b5649554.t: Harry seakan-akan mula teringat sesuatu. “Bertarung? Itu sama dengan pertarungan Gandew ke?”

8f3b3972fc52.en: Eiri continued massaging, with some of the blood staining her yellow gloves. “This is for the badge. Usually you would do this at an embassy, but Itagiba said he knew a contact that would cut some corners.”
8f3b3972fc52.t: Eiri terus mengurut, dengan sebahagian darah mengotorkan sarung tangan kuningnya. “Ni untuk lencana. Biasanya kau buat ni kat kedutaan, tapi Itagiba kata dia kenal seorang kenalan yang boleh potong jalan sikit.”

9021367ee94d.en: Eiri nonchalantly spoke, with a confident truth in her words. “That’s a no—which is okay. I mean—not everyone likes a strong, independent type. Sora though—I heard a bit from Itagiba—she tickles your fancy, huh?” A slight grim shone on Eiri’s face, as her hands went to pinch Harry in the belly.
9021367ee94d.t: Eiri bercakap dengan selamba, dengan kebenaran yang yakin dalam kata-katanya. “Maknanya tak—dan tak apa. Maksud aku—bukan semua orang suka jenis yang kuat dan berdikari. Sora pula—aku ada dengar sikit dari Itagiba—dia buat kau tergoda, ya?” Senyuman suram kecil bersinar di wajah Eiri, sementara tangannya pergi mencubit perut Harry.

99f19e1ffae3.en: Chapter V subchapter 1: the blonde girl looks worried holding a metal cup, with a dark-haired woman beside her.
99f19e1ffae3.t: Bab V subbab 1: gadis berambut perang kelihatan risau sambil memegang cawan logam, dengan seorang wanita berambut gelap di sebelahnya.

9aafcd063571.en: The door softly closed, with Neferteri not saying a word.
9aafcd063571.t: Pintu itu ditutup perlahan, dengan Neferteri tidak berkata sepatah pun.

9e4e20fd1113.en: “Here!” Eiri grabbed Harry’s bleeding hand, and quickly smeared it on the bottom right of the contract with a swipe, then placed the sliced thumb on top of the opened glass bottle. “Just hold still a little longer!”
9e4e20fd1113.t: “Sini!” Eiri memegang tangan Harry yang berdarah, dan dengan cepat menyapukannya ke bahagian bawah kanan kontrak dengan satu sapuan, kemudian meletakkan ibu jari yang terhiris itu di atas botol kaca yang terbuka. “Tahan sekejap lagi!”

9e7f8ff0d5eb.en: Letting a long breath, Eiri relaxed her shoulders. “Didn’t even knock on my office—” Eiri, now alone in her office, sat on a visitor chair by the table and put the bucket in her lap, holding it like an infant. Eiri began imitating Neferteri’s voice, but added a shrewish spin to it, including curled up lips, “The procedure the courtroom scientist decides to perform our monarchy department’s—shit—does not—does not concern me. Argh.” Eiri let out another sigh, taking off her blue cap and throwing it on top of the nearby table, sharing space with something akin to an abacus, feathers, inks, seals, and piles of neatly organized papers.
9e7f8ff0d5eb.t: Menghembus nafas panjang, Eiri mengendurkan bahunya. “Ketuk pintu pejabat aku pun tak—” Eiri, kini seorang diri di pejabatnya, duduk di kerusi pelawat di tepi meja dan meletakkan baldi itu di ribanya, memegangnya seperti bayi. Eiri mula meniru suara Neferteri, tetapi menambah gaya perempuan leter padanya, termasuk bibir yang mencebik, “Prosedur yang saintis istana putuskan untuk melakukan jabatan monarki kita—cis—tidak—tidak membimbangkan saya. Argh.” Eiri mengeluh lagi, menanggalkan topi birunya dan mencampakkannya ke atas meja berdekatan, berkongsi ruang dengan sesuatu seperti sempoa, bulu pena, dakwat, cop mohor, dan timbunan kertas yang tersusun kemas.

a192654b8237.en: Cleaning his tongue with his teeth, Harry looked like he had just tasted soured milk. “So what—hmmm.” Harry scratched his right eye as if he was growing sleepy, then he started scratching both as he struggled to keep them open.
a192654b8237.t: Membersihkan lidahnya dengan giginya, Harry kelihatan seperti baru merasa susu basi. “Jadi apa—hmmm.” Harry menggaru mata kanannya seolah-olah dia semakin mengantuk, kemudian dia mula menggaru kedua-duanya sambil bergelut untuk memastikannya terbuka.

a1aa02bfebc7.en: “Well, that’s not to say you wouldn’t win, but Maiara does pack a punch—but I guess I never asked, is she even your type?” Eiri leaned towards Harry, curiously awaiting.
a1aa02bfebc7.t: “Yalah, bukan nak kata kau takkan menang, tapi Maiara memang kuat menumbuk—tapi rasanya aku tak pernah tanya, dia jenis kau ke?” Eiri mencondongkan badan ke arah Harry, menunggu dengan ingin tahu.

a1cd72769539.en: “Ehh—why? Sora said she was gonna do it!” Eiri’s hand reached out to the bucket on its own, grasping its thin handle, just as Neferteri’s hand released the weight of it into hers. Her wide mouth kept open, peeking into the contents of the bucket. “But why do you want me to do it? I’m being impartial!”
a1cd72769539.t: “Ehh—kenapa? Sora kata dia yang nak buat!” Tangan Eiri terhulur ke baldi itu dengan sendirinya, menggenggam pemegangnya yang nipis, tepat ketika tangan Neferteri melepaskan beratnya ke tangan Eiri. Mulutnya yang ternganga luas kekal terbuka, mengintai isi baldi itu. “Tapi kenapa awak nak aku yang buat? Aku berkecuali!”

a2847217475a.en: “Next time I will let you do it yourself!” Eiri winked, releasing the spell on Harry’s arm.
a2847217475a.t: “Lain kali aku biar kau buat sendiri!” Eiri mengenyit mata, melepaskan jampi itu ke lengan Harry.

a33dfcba8bd7.en: Laughing alongside, she retreated to let Harry breathe. “You know, you can just fake the duel, too. No harm, no foul!”
a33dfcba8bd7.t: Ketawa bersama, dia berundur untuk membiarkan Harry bernafas. “Kau tahu, kau boleh je pura-pura bertarung. Tak ada siapa rugi!”

a3b037355979.en: “I think this makes more sense now. So, if I work to repay the five hundred sapphires debt, then I will be free?'' Harry scratched his head.
a3b037355979.t: “Rasanya ni lebih masuk akal sekarang. Jadi, kalau saya bekerja untuk bayar balik hutang lima ratus sapphire, saya akan bebas?'' Harry menggaru kepalanya.

a40cd364fb3b.en: “It’s like a blackish thing you hold in your hand, and move your finger like this—” Harry pulled a fictitious trigger with his index finger. “And then it makes a loud boom, and whatever you point at gets a hole about this big.” Harry used his index and thumb to make a circumference close to of a coin.
a40cd364fb3b.t: “Ia macam benda kehitaman yang kau pegang kat tangan, dan gerakkan jari macam ni—” Harry menarik picu yang tidak wujud dengan jari telunjuknya. “Lepas tu ia buat bunyi dentuman kuat, dan apa saja yang kau halakan dapat lubang lebih kurang sebesar ni.” Harry menggunakan jari telunjuk dan ibu jarinya untuk membuat bulatan hampir sebesar syiling.

a498cff3d076.en: Eiri continued her instructions, “Before you do anything with the knife, put that cloth aside, and open that glass jar, and bring it closer, too.”
a498cff3d076.t: Eiri meneruskan arahannya, “Sebelum kau buat apa-apa dengan pisau tu, letak kain tu ke tepi, dan buka balang kaca tu, dan dekatkan juga.”

a90add823e6d.t: Menambah baik? Eiri merasakan getaran yang menyeramkan.

a999a7d3f5dc.en: Harry hesitated at first, but with a deep breath that felt like a battle cry, he angrily shoved the spoon inside the nari gel, took another hors d'oeuvres, closed his eyes, and shoved it down his mouth in a sudden jerk motion. Immediately letting out another gag mixed with a groan, he gulped it down faster than before, then readied his spirit with an upright, firm sitting stance to repeat the process.
a999a7d3f5dc.t: Harry teragak-agak pada mulanya, tetapi dengan tarikan nafas dalam yang terasa seperti laungan perang, dia dengan marah menyumbat sudu itu ke dalam nari gel, mengambil satu lagi hors d'oeuvres, memejamkan matanya, dan menyumbatnya ke dalam mulut dengan sentapan tiba-tiba. Serta-merta mengeluarkan satu lagi rasa nak muntah bercampur erangan, dia menelannya lebih cepat daripada tadi, kemudian menyiapkan semangatnya dengan postur duduk tegak dan teguh untuk mengulangi proses itu.

ab555d63d3bc.en: With a heartwarming, toothy smile, and still moistened eyes, Harry cheerfully replied back “Thank you, Eiri.”
ab555d63d3bc.t: Dengan senyuman menampakkan gigi yang menyentuh hati, dan mata yang masih berkaca, Harry membalas dengan ceria “Terima kasih, Eiri.”

adedb33fbc4e.en: “Don’t you want good vision?” Eiri’s tone did not sound as amused as before, scooching halfway closer to Harry, getting the nari gel about an arm’s length from his mouth.
adedb33fbc4e.t: “Kau tak nak penglihatan yang bagus ke?” Nada Eiri tidak kedengaran terhibur seperti tadi, mengesot separuh jalan mendekati Harry, membawa nari gel itu kira-kira sedepa dari mulutnya.

b1e8a7e0d954.en: With a bright nod, Harry reached out to the contract, exchanging a smile with Eiri.
b1e8a7e0d954.t: Dengan anggukan ceria, Harry mencapai kontrak itu, bertukar senyuman dengan Eiri.

b4071c57df7d.en: Tears formed in her eyes, vividly picturing that day as if it had just happened.
b4071c57df7d.t: Air mata bergenang di matanya, membayangkan hari itu dengan jelas seolah-olah baru sahaja berlaku.

b4c01723315d.en: Eiri placed her gloved hand above the nari gel. “That’s okay. Two is all you need. Here.” Eiri grabbed it from Harry, and used both hands to tightly shove the large oval cork back into it.
b4c01723315d.t: Eiri meletakkan tangannya yang bersarung di atas nari gel itu. “Tak apa. Dua je yang kau perlukan. Nah.” Eiri mengambilnya dari Harry, dan menggunakan kedua-dua tangan untuk menyumbat semula gabus bujur besar itu ke dalamnya dengan ketat.

b5dd285eb82c.en: “It’s not explicitly mentioned on the contract, but you need one to sign it! Now grab that cloth, and wrap your thumb—squeeze to keep the wound closed, too.” Eiri smiled at Harry, grabbing what appeared to be a saltshaker, and doused the blood on the bottom right of the contract with it. Instead of salt, translucent bluish grains, the same color as the nari stone, mixed with the blood, and started drying on the paper. She then grabbed the contract, and carefully tapped the lower end onto the table to let the excess blood fall out, then began fanning it around. With her hands busy, she pointed her head towards the bottle, filled to about one fourth with blood. “Can you close that?”
b5dd285eb82c.t: “Ia tak disebut secara jelas dalam kontrak, tapi kau perlukannya untuk tandatangan! Sekarang ambil kain tu, dan balut ibu jari kau—picit supaya luka tu tertutup juga.” Eiri tersenyum kepada Harry, mengambil sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bekas garam, dan menaburkannya ke atas darah di bawah kanan kontrak. Bukannya garam, butiran lut sinar kebiruan, sama warna dengan batu nari, bercampur dengan darah, dan mula kering di atas kertas. Dia kemudian mengambil kontrak itu, dan dengan berhati-hati mengetuk hujung bawahnya ke meja untuk membiarkan darah berlebihan jatuh, kemudian mula mengipasnya. Dengan tangannya sibuk, dia menghalakan kepalanya ke arah botol itu, berisi darah kira-kira suku penuh. “Boleh kau tutup tu?”

b715c17c8152.en: “You know, I’ve been king-maid for about a year and a half now. I thought my mother taught me everything.” Eiri let out a long-winded breath, letting Harry go, seriously glancing at his drooping eyes. “But even I feel lost at a times, too. I’m sorry, Harry, but I’m gonna come clean—”
b715c17c8152.t: “Kau tahu, aku dah jadi king-maid lebih kurang setahun setengah sekarang. Aku ingat mak aku dah ajar aku semuanya.” Eiri menghembus nafas panjang, melepaskan Harry, memandang serius matanya yang layu. “Tapi aku pun kadang-kadang rasa hilang arah juga. Maaf, Harry, tapi aku nak berterus terang—”

b9eed4fa8dc8.en: “Convince him—” With her chin up, and an absolute tone, Neferteri’s usual elegance seemed to vanish in place of an autocrat-looking queen, handing out a bucket…
b9eed4fa8dc8.t: “Yakinkan dia—” Dengan dagu terangkat, dan nada yang mutlak, keanggunan biasa Neferteri seakan-akan lenyap digantikan oleh permaisuri yang kelihatan seperti seorang autokrat, menyerahkan sebuah baldi…

b9f61d41c953.en: Sitting away from her, Harry forced a groan as his body refused to come closer. The slightly vinegary and salty scent of the nari gel exuding from the open bottle probably didn’t help matters either.
b9f61d41c953.t: Duduk jauh darinya, Harry memaksa erangan ketika tubuhnya enggan mendekat. Bau nari gel yang sedikit cuka dan masin yang terpancar dari botol terbuka itu mungkin tidak membantu juga.

ba2e78feb1d1.en: Holding the contract, Harry read out loud, “The contractor will have full control over contractee’s state, and will remain doing so until the aforementioned debt is repaid.” His eyes scanned the next line, while his mouth slowly spoke the words, trying to correctly enunciate its floweriness. “Repayment shall be done at reimbursement of leftover market tier one daily wages for each day the contractee submits his state, and will to the contractor. In the event of contractee’s unwillingness to partake in his responsibilities to said contract, punishments can be given at the contractor’s discretion, unless said discretion violates Prosperity Law Section Four, Sub Three and Four. ” Looking at Eiri with a dead stare as if he had just read some ancient curse, Harry eagerly waited for a translation.
ba2e78feb1d1.t: Memegang kontrak itu, Harry membaca dengan kuat, “Pihak yang berkontrak akan mempunyai kawalan penuh ke atas keadaan pihak yang dikontrak, dan akan terus berbuat demikian sehingga hutang yang disebut di atas dilunaskan.” Matanya mengimbas baris seterusnya, sementara mulutnya perlahan-lahan menyebut perkataan-perkataan itu, cuba menyebut keberbungaannya dengan betul. “Pembayaran balik hendaklah dibuat melalui pembayaran semula baki gaji harian peringkat satu pasaran bagi setiap hari pihak yang dikontrak menyerahkan keadaan, dan kemahuannya kepada pihak yang berkontrak. Sekiranya pihak yang dikontrak enggan menjalankan tanggungjawabnya terhadap kontrak tersebut, hukuman boleh dikenakan mengikut budi bicara pihak yang berkontrak, melainkan budi bicara tersebut melanggar Undang-undang Kemakmuran Seksyen Empat, Subseksyen Tiga dan Empat. ” Memandang Eiri dengan renungan mati seolah-olah dia baru membaca sumpahan purba, Harry menunggu terjemahan dengan tidak sabar.

ba4af4dfdba8.en: “No—use the other end. You need some of the jelly too. Like this—” Eiri switched sides of the picker in Harry’s hand, and then held his hand to correctly spoon the nari gel. “Just take it out slowly.”
ba4af4dfdba8.t: “Bukan—guna hujung yang satu lagi. Kau perlukan sikit jeli juga. Macam ni—” Eiri menukar hujung picker di tangan Harry, dan kemudian memegang tangannya untuk menyudu nari gel itu dengan betul. “Keluarkan perlahan-lahan.”

ba9188aa21a3.en: Chapter V subchapter 4: Harry writes at a table while an egua-drawn wagon passes outside in a cloud of dust.
ba9188aa21a3.t: Bab V subbab 4: Harry menulis di meja sementara sebuah kereta kuda ditarik egua melintas di luar dalam kepulan debu.

bb54997f6abc.en: “Convince him—” With her chin up, and an absolute tone, Neferteri’s usual elegance seemed to vanish in place of an autocrat-looking queen, handing out a bucket with a rolled contract, nari gels, towel, and utensils.
bb54997f6abc.t: “Yakinkan dia—” Dengan dagu terangkat, dan nada yang mutlak, keanggunan biasa Neferteri seakan-akan lenyap digantikan oleh permaisuri yang kelihatan seperti seorang autokrat, menyerahkan sebuah baldi berisi kontrak yang digulung, nari gel, tuala dan perkakas.

bcbd195676bd.en: “I know, right? See? I told ya so!” Eiri chuckled, patting Harry’s head from the back.
bcbd195676bd.t: “Tahu, kan? Nampak? Aku dah cakap!” Eiri tergelak kecil, menepuk kepala Harry dari belakang.

c2f9e72b6603.en: Procure a way for him to sign, and avoid indulging in your mother’s tendencies. Commit to those, and we shall be more prosperous than any other kingdom. Otherwise, you should look forward to an early retirement. Neferteri’s voice echoed in Eiri’s mind. Straining her eyebrows to purge the thought out, she slipped out a soft thought, Everything will work out. She hugged Harry tightly from the side. “I will help you find where you came from, and I promise I will even get some PTO to visit it with you.”
c2f9e72b6603.t: Dapatkan cara untuk dia menandatangan, dan elakkan daripada menurut kecenderungan ibu anda. Komitlah pada kedua-duanya, dan kita akan lebih makmur daripada mana-mana kerajaan lain. Jika tidak, anda boleh menantikan persaraan awal. Suara Neferteri bergema dalam fikiran Eiri. Menegangkan keningnya untuk menyingkirkan fikiran itu, dia membisikkan satu fikiran lembut, Semuanya akan beres. Dia memeluk Harry erat-erat dari sisi. “Aku akan tolong kau cari dari mana kau datang, dan aku janji aku siap akan ambil cuti untuk melawatnya dengan kau.”

c37dc7c47ae1.en: “Maybe more if it was from a famous person, but that’s more of a Forway thing—definitely from someone born with supernatural eyesight. That could cost another amethyst. For sure.” Taking out a picker from the bucket, Eiri handed it towards Harry “Use this to swallow one eyeball at a time—and please don’t drop it on the sheets.”
c37dc7c47ae1.t: “Mungkin lebih kalau dari orang terkenal, tapi itu lebih kepada budaya Forway—mesti dari seseorang yang lahir dengan penglihatan luar biasa. Itu boleh makan satu amethyst lagi. Pasti.” Mengeluarkan sebatang picker dari baldi, Eiri menghulurkannya kepada Harry “Guna ni untuk telan sebiji mata demi sebiji—dan tolong jangan jatuhkan atas cadar.”

c413c467f672.en: Chapter V - Being Friendly · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
c413c467f672.t: Bab V - Bersikap Mesra · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

c4a1a7dd9e6b.en: Gulping again, Harry brought the spoon towards his not-so-enthusiastic wide mouth, and popped the eyeball in like a large pill. A loud gag immediately came out of him, belching forward, but somehow stopping himself in the last second from actually emptying his mouth. Next, a small tear came from his tightly shut eyes.
c4a1a7dd9e6b.t: Menelan liur lagi, Harry membawa sudu itu ke mulutnya yang ternganga tetapi tidak berapa bersemangat, dan memasukkan biji mata itu seperti pil besar. Rasa nak muntah yang kuat serta-merta keluar daripadanya, tersembur ke depan, tetapi entah bagaimana menahan dirinya pada saat terakhir daripada benar-benar mengosongkan mulutnya. Kemudian, setitis air mata kecil keluar dari matanya yang terpejam rapat.

c7d2c44aa083.en: Eiri brought the bucket close to her chest, and hugged it with both hands. Blinking faster than normal, she replied. “What are you talking about? I didn’t do anything!”
c7d2c44aa083.t: Eiri membawa baldi itu rapat ke dadanya, dan memeluknya dengan kedua-dua tangan. Berkelip lebih laju daripada biasa, dia menjawab. “Apa awak merepek ni? Aku tak buat apa-apa pun!”

c7dee7177c56.en: “Yeah, like that! But more rectangle-like—” Harry used his index fingers to stare at Eiri with a much smaller looking glass, at least compared to what she imagined.
c7dee7177c56.t: “Ha, macam tu! Tapi lebih macam segi empat tepat—” Harry menggunakan jari telunjuknya untuk merenung Eiri dengan kanta yang kelihatan jauh lebih kecil, sekurang-kurangnya berbanding apa yang dia bayangkan.

c9fb3c1c8185.en: Eiri looked back at the tensed-up Harry, “It’s okay. The winner must revive the loser, or the audience will kill the winner—oh! Actually, this duel is a hybrid. It is Gandew, but Itagiba will declare the winner instead—so no death.”
c9fb3c1c8185.t: Eiri memandang semula Harry yang tegang, “Tak apa. Pemenang mesti hidupkan semula yang kalah, kalau tak penonton akan bunuh pemenang—oh! Sebenarnya, pertarungan ni hibrid. Ia Gandew, tapi Itagiba yang akan isytiharkan pemenang—jadi tak ada kematian.”

cb323751a035.en: Letting out a grunt, Harry slowly picked up the nari gel from Eiri’s gloved hands. “One amethyst and twenty pearls?” He brought it up close to his blurry eyes, likely noticing a slightly translucent grainy suspension mixed in with the gel. Not exactly the most palatable thing ever, but the cold touch of the glass probably didn’t help either—or did help since a warm glass would suggest a fresh batch, and that was clearly a human eyeball that had to come out of a possibly nearby human.
cb323751a035.t: Merengus, Harry perlahan-lahan mengambil nari gel itu dari tangan Eiri yang bersarung. “Satu amethyst dan dua puluh Pearl?” Dia mendekatkannya ke matanya yang kabur, mungkin perasan ampaian berbutir yang sedikit lut sinar bercampur dalam gel itu. Bukanlah benda yang paling menyelerakan, tetapi sentuhan sejuk kaca itu mungkin tidak membantu juga—atau memang membantu kerana kaca yang hangat akan membayangkan kelompok yang baru, dan itu jelas biji mata manusia yang terpaksa dikeluarkan daripada manusia yang mungkin berada berdekatan.

cbb625dd0abb.en: The painting of her mother appeared to stare back with a smirk, as if taunting her. “Don’t look at me like that! I can’t just start doing whatever I feel like! You had Gabiro on your side!—these maids depend on me! Can’t you imagine how terrified Sora would be of Neferteri?”
cbb625dd0abb.t: Lukisan ibunya seakan-akan merenung balik dengan senyum sinis, seolah-olah mengejeknya. “Jangan pandang aku macam tu! Aku tak boleh mula buat sesuka hati aku! Mak ada Gabiro di pihak mak!—pembantu-pembantu rumah ni bergantung pada aku! Mak tak boleh bayangkan betapa takutnya Sora pada Neferteri?”

ccc8abbca7ef.en: “I knew it!” Eiri pinched his fat belly, making sure to attack his thick love handles.
ccc8abbca7ef.t: “Dah agak dah!” Eiri mencubit perut gemuknya, memastikan menyerang lemak tepi pinggangnya yang tebal.

cd2629e38eb0.en: “Is that what a Sanbi-eye is?” An intrigued curiosity arose out of him “So, what I would be doing?”
cd2629e38eb0.t: “Itu ke Sanbi-eye?” Rasa ingin tahu yang tertarik timbul daripadanya “Jadi, apa yang saya akan buat?”

cd6a1328fbd4.en: Eiri paused, fanning the contract around. “Mostly there.” She laid out the contract back on the table, then went to the bathroom to wash her bloodied gloved hands.
cd6a1328fbd4.t: Eiri berhenti seketika, mengipas kontrak itu. “Hampir siap.” Dia membentangkan semula kontrak itu di atas meja, kemudian pergi ke bilik mandi untuk mencuci tangannya yang bersarung dan berdarah.

ce279ad8102a.en: “Quick! This is not a tasting event! Just swallow it!” Eiri placed her hand on Harry’s bent forward upper back, rubbing her yellow gloves back and forth on Harry’s back, where a yellow and blue refined, stretched-to-the-limit dress shirt hid his hairiness. “There! You know, actually, some people don’t mind the salty taste.” She loudly chuckled, picturing the bustling end of some personal adventurers she had had with members of the opposite sex.
ce279ad8102a.t: “Cepat! Ini bukan acara rasa-rasa! Telan je!” Eiri meletakkan tangannya pada belakang atas Harry yang membongkok ke depan, menggosok sarung tangan kuningnya ke depan dan ke belakang pada belakang Harry, di mana kemeja kuning dan biru yang halus dan teregang hingga ke had menyembunyikan bulunya. “Haa! Kau tahu, sebenarnya, ada orang tak kisah rasa masin tu.” Dia tergelak kuat, membayangkan penghujung yang hiruk-pikuk beberapa pengembaraan peribadi yang pernah dilaluinya dengan ahli jantina berlawanan.

d0e662815ba2.en: Eiri let out a long exhale. Her green eyes wandered the floor. “I really don’t know what you are going through, but I promise I will help you.” She took Harry’s head, and brought it to her shoulder, only to hear a sniff, which then turned into more sniffs, that then evolved into a crybaby. I guess that’s what mothers do? But if he is this much of a crybaby, then Maiara will turn him inside out—for sure.
d0e662815ba2.t: Eiri menghembus nafas panjang. Mata hijaunya melilau di lantai. “Aku betul-betul tak tahu apa yang kau lalui, tapi aku janji aku akan tolong kau.” Dia mengambil kepala Harry, dan membawanya ke bahunya, hanya untuk mendengar satu hingusan, yang kemudian menjadi lebih banyak hingusan, yang kemudian berevolusi menjadi tangisan budak cengeng. Rasanya inilah yang ibu-ibu buat? Tapi kalau dia secengeng ni, Maiara akan terbalikkan dia dalam ke luar—pasti.

d12311bb3c6e.en: Neferteri closed her eyes for a few seconds, releasing a slow breath. Opening her eyes, she stared down Eiri with the same intensity as if she was aiming at her with a rifle. “Impartiality? —you’re really no different than Coema.”
d12311bb3c6e.t: Neferteri memejamkan matanya selama beberapa saat, menghembus nafas perlahan. Membuka matanya, dia merenung Eiri dengan keamatan yang sama seolah-olah dia sedang membidiknya dengan senapang. “Berkecuali? —anda memang tidak ada bezanya dengan Coema.”

d4bcf4e1eca5.en: Harry gave a thumbs up, with the same thumb that was previously sliced, now looking just fine.
d4bcf4e1eca5.t: Harry mengangkat ibu jari, dengan ibu jari yang sama yang terhiris tadi, kini kelihatan baik-baik sahaja.

d9750126b4e3.en: “So we’re ignoring the fact that Gabiro messed with his soul?” Eiri shouted slightly higher, using the last ounce of will she had.
d9750126b4e3.t: “Jadi kita tak endahkan hakikat yang Gabiro main-main dengan jiwa dia?” Eiri menjerit sedikit lebih tinggi, menggunakan sisa terakhir kemahuan yang ada padanya.

d979c3283938.en: Harry cackled, trying to defend his hands from Eiri’s pinchers, but it was to no avail.
d979c3283938.t: Harry terkekeh-kekeh, cuba mempertahankan dengan tangannya daripada cubitan Eiri, tetapi sia-sia sahaja.

da8a63c60f33.en: Harry followed suit, then grabbed the short knife, observing its sharpness, and the woodwork required to carve and paint the Sanbi symbol.
da8a63c60f33.t: Harry menurut, kemudian mengambil pisau pendek itu, memerhati ketajamannya, dan kerja kayu yang diperlukan untuk mengukir dan melukis simbol Sanbi.

dc02ffc3a4b9.en: “How—how does that work?” Apparently having an epiphany, at least by the sudden jarring motion of his head, Harry continued “Glasses! I just realized I wore glasses! I don’t need them anymore!”
dc02ffc3a4b9.t: “Macam—macam mana itu berfungsi?” Nampaknya mendapat ilham, sekurang-kurangnya dari gerakan kepalanya yang tiba-tiba tersentak, Harry menyambung “Cermin mata! Saya baru sedar saya pakai cermin mata! Saya tak perlukannya lagi!”

df6cf7e884ff.en: “Is that really the best way to fix my sight?” With a thin lip, Harry sounded rather begging for an answer—a specific one.
df6cf7e884ff.t: “Itu betul-betul cara terbaik nak betulkan penglihatan saya ke?” Dengan bibir menipis, Harry kedengaran agak merayu untuk satu jawapan—jawapan yang khusus.

e0e603d32b88.en: “Thank you—” A mutter came out of Harry, still enjoying Eiri's comforting shoulder as he cozily breathed like a baby being cradled by his mother.
e0e603d32b88.t: “Terima kasih—” Satu gumaman keluar daripada Harry, masih menikmati bahu Eiri yang menenangkan sambil bernafas dengan selesa seperti bayi yang didodoi ibunya.

e3ac8779d3c4.en: “Ohhh!” Harry seemed to forget his sliced thumb, excitingly saying, “So I will really have my own badge? Just like yours?”
e3ac8779d3c4.t: “Ohhh!” Harry seakan-akan terlupa ibu jarinya yang terhiris, berkata dengan teruja, “Jadi saya betul-betul akan ada lencana sendiri? Sama macam awak punya?”

e42e81067c74.en: “Will it hurt?” Harry looked at the remaining two eyeballs, staring at him macabrely.
e42e81067c74.t: “Sakit ke nanti?” Harry memandang dua biji mata yang tinggal, merenungnya dengan mengerikan.

e7388caea441.en: “Ahh—hmmm—I dunno. I just talked to him early today.” Eiri quickly replied, glancing around the office for an answer or two. She saw the bookshelves in the middle of the room, looking like they were specifically intended to triage documents. The bookshelves on her right looked more like they contained bins of documents had been dumped on them, while the ones on her left looked progressively more organized. On the left wall, there was a large steel door that looked like a bank’s safe. “I told him to read books, and stuff like that. What’s the big deal?” Surrounding the walls, there were mannequins displaying previous Sanbi kingdom maid uniforms, with progressively aging paintings of previous king-maids matching above them. She looked at the one closest to her, a king-maid outfit that resembled her own image, with a similar haircut and single white flower in her head—kinda had a vibe of chanteuse, one that you see sexily singing on top of a piano in a random VHS cop drama nightclub scene. The painting showed a more bodacious, revealing version of Eiri’s uniform on the shoulders and breasts. Looking back at Neferteri with a slight grin, she seemed to feel the soul of the painting being infused into her. “—or maybe he thought I was hot?—I am just like my mother after all!”
e7388caea441.t: “Ahh—hmmm—entahlah. Aku cuma bercakap dengan dia tadi.” Eiri menjawab dengan pantas, mengerling sekeliling pejabat mencari satu dua jawapan. Dia nampak rak-rak buku di tengah bilik, kelihatan seperti sengaja dimaksudkan untuk mengasingkan dokumen. Rak-rak buku di sebelah kanannya lebih kelihatan seperti tong-tong dokumen dilambakkan ke atasnya, manakala yang di sebelah kirinya kelihatan semakin tersusun. Di dinding kiri, ada pintu keluli besar yang kelihatan seperti peti besi bank. “Aku suruh dia baca buku, dan benda-benda macam tu. Apa yang besar sangat?” Mengelilingi dinding, ada mannequin yang memperagakan seragam pembantu rumah kerajaan Sanbi terdahulu, dengan lukisan king-maid terdahulu yang semakin lama semakin tua sepadan di atasnya. Dia memandang yang paling dekat dengannya, pakaian king-maid yang menyerupai imejnya sendiri, dengan potongan rambut yang serupa dan sekuntum bunga putih di kepalanya—agak beraura seorang penyanyi kelab, yang kau nampak menyanyi dengan seksi di atas piano dalam adegan kelab malam drama polis VHS yang rawak. Lukisan itu menunjukkan versi seragam Eiri yang lebih montok dan terdedah di bahu dan dada. Memandang semula Neferteri dengan sengihan kecil, dia seakan-akan merasakan jiwa lukisan itu meresap ke dalam dirinya. “—atau mungkin dia rasa aku hot?—lagipun aku sama macam mak aku!”

ebbcaa3640ec.en: Eiri felt her lungs tightening, but she could breathe just fine. “You okay?” She asked, carefully watching over Harry’s conversation turning into a monologue.
ebbcaa3640ec.t: Eiri merasakan paru-parunya menyempit, tetapi dia boleh bernafas dengan baik. “Kau okey?” Dia bertanya, memerhati dengan teliti perbualan Harry yang bertukar menjadi monolog.

ef88063a98e0.en: “I see! Already mister independent, huh? Just don’t let that confidence go to your head and woo Sora away from me, okay? Or at least don't go too hard on her if you become Sanbi-eye!” Eiri waved goodbye, winking as she closed the door, and began to fast walk towards the spiraling stairs. Passing by one of the closed windows, she saw the city she called home bathed in a familiar green moonshine. She bit her cheeks, looking at the sleeping city, except for a bar in the distance where a live band played, and people danced around as if it was just another day.
ef88063a98e0.t: “Oh begitu! Dah jadi encik berdikari, ya? Cuma jangan biar keyakinan tu naik ke kepala dan pikat Sora jauh dari aku, okey?
